counterCase.en: if it loses 1,659.50 and the bounce does not hold, the 24h downtrend continues toward yesterday's low and its first extension (1,607.29); today's trend checklist is actually aligned bearish across all three frames (daily, 4h, 1h), unlike yesterday, and ETH's long accounts remain over the 3-to-1 cutoff (retail crowded long): fuel for another sweep if the bounce fails. Extreme fear (13, a ~69h-old reading) cuts both ways: if there really is fresh panic the feed missed, wicks get bought back fast, but if the panic is real and new, today's bounce could just be a pause.
